task.title: Junction corner cases: fetch, refusal and stripped duplicates
task.problem: Three junction defects found with a nested-junction probe: --fetch-subprojects crashed with "'NoneType' object is not callable" because the scheduler calls Stream's ticker and interrupt callbacks unconditionally; the refusal for an unfetched junction did not name the junction or how to fix it; and --strip-junctions de-duplicated distinct trees that share a stripped element name and path, hiding real matches.
task.proposal: Give Stream non-interactive ticker/interrupt callbacks, name the missing junctions and the bst command in the refusal, and include the matched text in the strip-junctions de-duplication key.
acceptance: --fetch-subprojects reaches the per-element result (uncached element error) instead of a TypeError.
Without --fetch-subprojects the error names the unfetched junction.
Nested junction elements (a.bst:b.bst:c.bst), link elements and nested targets are searched.
--strip-junctions reports both lines when distinct trees share a stripped name and path.
evidence: tests/test_integration.py::test_junctions_nested_fetch_strip_and_targets fails on the previous code and passes with the fix.
